zh: 每走一步都花 1 秒，所以“能否在 maxTime 内到达”等价于“最短步数是否不超过 maxTime”。
边权全为 1 的网格最短路用广度优先搜索：BFS 按距离从小到大出队，第一次到达终点时的距离就是最少用时。
从 (0,0) 开始 BFS，只走到界内、是 '.' 且未访问的格子。终点出队时比较距离与 maxTime 输出 Yes 或 No；距离已经等于 maxTime 的格子不必再扩展。队列耗尽仍未到达则输出 No。
en: Every step costs one second, so reaching the target within maxTime is the same as the shortest number of steps being at most maxTime.
For a grid where every move costs 1, use breadth-first search: BFS dequeues cells in increasing distance, so the first time the target is reached gives the minimum time.

BFS from (0,0), moving only to in-bounds, unvisited '.' cells. When the target is dequeued, print Yes if its distance is at most maxTime and No otherwise; cells already at distance maxTime need no expansion. If the queue empties first, print No.

explanationEn:
## Idea

Run a breadth-first search for the shortest distance; when the target is reached compare the distance with the limit. Layers beyond the limit need not be expanded.

## Correctness

Every edge costs 1 and BFS processes cells in increasing distance, so the first time the target is reached gives the minimum time. A plan within the limit exists exactly when that distance does not exceed the limit.

## Complexity

O(rc) time, O(rc) space.
